name: smwgraphics-densetsu-no-stafy-2-world
title: Densetsu no Stafy 2 - World 1 (Underground)
description:
This game is also known as The Legendary Starfy 2 outside Japan. This area is set inside a cave. Made the BG use palette 0, back area color is used, as it's the darkest color, the SMW status bar colors are unaffected and an extra color is salvaged.
Besides the cave palette, it comes with 3 more palettes:
-underwater;
-volcano made by me;
-alternate dimension also made by me;
Enjoy! No credit necessary.
